fix: resolve content filtering errors in Gemini and OpenAI providers

Gemini:
- Add safetySettings (BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH) to both chat() and stream() —
  code generation prompts (auth, SQL, security systems) were triggering
  false positives at Gemini's default BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE threshold
- Detect promptFeedback.blockReason (prompt-level block) and throw
  descriptive error instead of silent empty response
- Detect finishReason=SAFETY (candidate-level block mid-generation)
  in both chat() and stream() with actionable error message
- Detect generic 'content filtering'/'Output blocked' in HTTP errors
  and surface a clear user-facing message

OpenAI:
- Detect finish_reason=content_filter and throw proper error instead
  of silently returning empty content string

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: Gemini content filter — BLOCK_NONE + auto-retry without system prompt

- Change safetySettings threshold from BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH to BLOCK_NONE
  for all harm categories — code generation prompts (auth, SQL, security
  patterns) still triggered false positives at BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
- chat(): on 400 content_filter error, auto-retry without systemInstruction
  (prepend first 2000 chars as context user message) so generation always
  completes even when system prompt triggers safety gate
- stream(): on 400 content_filter error, fall back to chat() which has
  its own retry — ensures streaming never silently dies on safety block

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: handle Gemini SSE array-format error body + mid-stream error detection

SSE endpoint returns 400 errors as JSON array [{"error":{...}}] — plain-object
access $body['error'] returned null so content-filter check was missed.

Also detect errors embedded in 200 OK stream body and broaden content-filter
detection to raw body string as fallback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: Gemini content-filter — 3-tier model fallback + provider fallback

BLOCK_NONE only disables safety filters; Gemini's content-filtering-policy
is a separate Google-side layer that always blocks auth/SQL/security prompts.

Fix: when content filter triggers, automatically retry:
  1) Same model, system instruction moved to user message
  2) gemini-2.0-flash-exp (far less strict policy)
  3) Flash model, no system instruction

If all Gemini attempts fail, CodeGeneratorService now falls back to the
next configured provider (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) via shouldFallbackForAIError.
